tema: Faça a narração em inglês com o tema o vulto na encruzilhada
legenda: Você teria coragem de passar por uma encruzilhada deserta à meia-noite? Escreva nos comentários qual seria a sua reação nessa situação macabra! 👻 #terror #historiasdehorror #suspense #misterio
falas: I made a huge mistake taking the midnight shortcut through the isolated crossroads, and now something is hunting me.
My car engine suddenly shut down at the dark intersection, and all the streetlights flickered out one by one.
Through the foggy windshield, I saw a tall shadowy figure standing unnaturally still right in the center.
I desperately turned the ignition key, but the dark entity began gliding toward my car without moving its legs.
An icy chill filled the vehicle just as a dark slender hand tapped heavily on my driver side window.
When I looked up, I gasped because the terrifying silhouette had no face, only glowing hollow eyes.
The car door just unlocked by itself and the shadow is sitting right next to me. What would you do?
